children: TORONTO, ON / ACCESS Newswire / September 23, 2026 /
Boba Mint Holdings Ltd.
("Boba Mint" or the "Company")
is pleased to report strong early subscription adoption following the soft launch of
Amino Pro
, the premium subscription offering within its AI-powered nutrition and health platform, Amino.

During the first 45 days following the soft launch, Amino had over 1,800 users subscribe to Amino Pro. Roughly 42% of these subscriptions came from the existing free user base, and 58% were new users to Amino with an average conversion rate of 4.5%"
Of those paid subscribers:
selected a monthly subscription;
selected an annual subscription; and
subscribed to the Lifetime subscription
The Company views the initial positive results and soft-launch traction as an important early indication of Amino's ability to monetize its growing user base through recurring subscription products.
Importantly, these results were generated during a
soft launch period
, prior to a broader marketing and subscriber-acquisition campaign for Amino Pro.

"We built Amino with the goal of creating a product people use frequently and find genuinely valuable, and the next step was determining whether a meaningful portion of that audience would be willing to pay for an enhanced experience," said
Andrew Shore, Chief Executive Officer of Boba Mint Holdings Ltd.

"The early subscription results are encouraging because they demonstrate that users are converting to paid plans even before we have fully activated our marketing strategy around Amino Pro. Our focus now is continuing to improve the product, conversion and subscriber retention as we scale."
Amino Pro
Amino's free offering remains available to users, while Amino Pro provides an optional premium subscription for users seeking additional functionality and insights.
Amino Pro includes premium features such as:
Unlimited meal logging;
AI processing up to five times faster;
A Personal AI Health Coach;
Tracking of more than 30 advanced nutrition metrics (e.g., vitamins like A and B, minerals, detailed carbohydrates, etc.);
Personalized AI insights, trends and analysis over time;
Enhanced member benefits, including 2X Amino Points;
Priority support; and
Early access to selected new features.

Amino Pro is currently offered through $8.99-$10.99 USD monthly, $28.99-$43.99 USD annually, and $94.99-$118.99 USD lifetime subscription options (please note that prices are subject to change and vary by country and region).

The Company believes the introduction of a recurring subscription model represents an important evolution for Amino as it seeks to build multiple sustainable monetization channels around its user base and technology platform.
Management intends to continue monitoring subscriber growth, conversion, retention and engagement as Amino Pro moves beyond its initial soft launch phase.
